name: editSubjectDetails
description:
Updates a subject record. Searches for a subject by code or subject name, opens the record, enters edit mode, and saves the updated values.
The user must provide either subjectCode OR subjectName to identify the record.
The user must provide at least one update field (newSubjectName, qualificationCode, or qualificationName)
Both update fields are optional - only fields the user provides will be changed
For qualification, the user can use either qualificationCode or qualificationName (not both)

basic.name: editSubjectDetails
basic.description:
Updates a subject record. Searches for a subject by code or subject name, opens the record, enters edit mode, and saves the updated values.
The user must provide either subjectCode OR subjectName to identify the record.
The user must provide at least one update field (newSubjectName, qualificationCode, or qualificationName)
Both update fields are optional - only fields the user provides will be changed
For qualification, the user can use either qualificationCode or qualificationName (not both)

args.name: subjectCode
args.description: The unique subject code to identify which record to update (e.g., "000001", "000008")

args.name: subjectName
args.description: The subject name or partial name to idenstify which record to update (e.g., "Physics", "Big Data", "OOP")

args.name: newSubjectName
args.description: The new name for the subject (e.g., "Advanced Physics", "Introduction to Programming")

args.name: qualificationCode
args.description: The qualification code (6-digit, e.g., "000004") or qualification name (e.g., "G C E Advanced Level Examination 2022") to associate with this subject

args.name: qualificationName
args.description: The qualification name to associate with this subject (e.g., "BSc (Hons) Computer Science")
